title: Fixture: deep TMS of insula and prefrontal cortex for smoking cessation
authors: Alpha A, Beta B, et al.
summary: This fixture trial tested deep TMS for smoking cessation in adult smokers. Active stimulation increased continuous abstinence compared with sham. Cigarette consumption and craving decreased more in the active group.

title: Fixture: left DLPFC rTMS reduces alcohol craving
summary: Detoxified patients with alcohol use disorder received left DLPFC rTMS or sham. Active rTMS reduced alcohol craving scores at the end of treatment. Relapse rates at three months did not differ between arms.

title: Fixture: right DLPFC rTMS for PTSD in combat veterans
summary: Combat veterans with PTSD were randomized to right DLPFC rTMS or sham. PTSD symptom severity improved more with active stimulation. Benefits persisted at six month follow-up.

title: Fixture: rTMS for cocaine use disorder
summary: Outpatients with cocaine use disorder received high-frequency left DLPFC rTMS. Cocaine-free urine tests were more frequent in the active group. Cocaine craving was reduced compared with pharmacological care.
